title: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 2

entities.name: Wayta
entities.description: A young Sun Empire warrior scarred in the war against the Phyrexians, who once sailed with the Brazen Coalition and now guards Huatli's expedition; she solves the glyph-bridge riddle.

entities.name: Huatli
entities.description: The Sun Empire's warrior-poet and a planeswalker who leads the expedition into the caverns, carrying a globe of the Threefold Sun's light.

entities.name: Quintorius Kand
entities.description: A loxodon planeswalker and archaeomancer, Huatli's assistant, who reanimates a ghost from a poncho with the spell 'The Rousing'.

entities.name: Inti
entities.description: An Imperial officer sent by the emperor to aid Huatli's expedition.

entities.name: Caparocti
entities.description: An Imperial officer on the expedition who believes war with the Dusk Legion is coming and that might protects the empire.

entities.name: Pantlaza
entities.description: A usually well-behaved dinosaur on the expedition who trills and growls his displeasure in the dark.

entities.name: Asterion
entities.description: Quint's old mentor, whom he wishes could see the underground city.

entities.name: Malcolm
entities.description: A siren and Brazen Coalition emissary leading a crew down the Downtown mine in search of the missing residents; his singing enthralls enemies.

entities.name: Breeches
entities.description: A goblin pirate who accompanies Malcolm and screeches 'no gold, no gems' and 'big boom'.

entities.name: Lank
entities.description: A dead Downtown miner whose corpse was overgrown with mushrooms.

entities.name: Captain Vance
entities.description: The Brazen Coalition captain who owes Malcolm a rest if he succeeds.

entities.name: Vito Quijano de Pasamonte
entities.description: A vampire hierophant who leads the expedition, believes himself chosen by Aclazotz, and sacrifices servants to open doors.

entities.name: Bartolomé del Presidio
entities.description: Queen's Bay Company director whose loyalties Vito distrusts; he fights the mantis-spiders with an enchanted whip.

entities.name: Amalia Benavides Aguirre
entities.description: A vampire cartomancer who maps the expedition's path, hears a voice calling to her, and saves Kellan by altering her map.

entities.name: Clavileño
entities.description: Vito's vampire soldier who can turn his legs to smoke and fly; he scouts the desert and leads the soldiers.

entities.name: Kellan
entities.description: A pointed-eared swordsman from Eldraine with glowing twig-hilted blades, rescued by Amalia from pale goblin-like creatures.

entities.name: Aclazotz
entities.description: The bat-winged vampire god whom Vito believes calls to him and demands sacrifices.

entities.name: Venerable Tarrian
entities.description: The figure whose journal and lance Vito carries.

entities.name: Saint Elenda
entities.description: A saint whose scriptures the church and Queen Miralda follow and Vito rejects.

entities.name: Queen Miralda
entities.description: The queen to whom Bartolomé is thought to send riches.

entities.name: Tilonalli
entities.description: A Sun Empire deity to whom Wayta prays for strength.

entities.name: Threefold Sun
entities.description: The Sun Empire's deity, whose light Huatli carries and which watched over Wayta.

entities.name: Ixalan
entities.description: The plane where the expeditions descend into caverns.

entities.name: Downtown
entities.description: The abandoned mining camp whose cenote shaft Malcolm descends.

entities.name: Tocatli
entities.description: A battlefield where Wayta served in the war.

entities.name: Alta Torrezon
entities.description: The vampire homeland that Vito wants to bring Aclazotz to.

entities.name: Zantafar
entities.description: A city that the underground city reminds Quint of.

entities.name: Sun Empire
entities.description: The empire Wayta and the Imperial officers serve.

entities.name: Brazen Coalition
entities.description: The pirate coalition Wayta once sailed with and Malcolm serves.

entities.name: Queen's Bay Company
entities.description: The company of which Bartolomé is a director.

entities.name: Dusk Legion
entities.description: The vampire army of Torrezon with which the Sun Empire expects war.

entities.name: Phyrexians
entities.description: The invaders in the war that scarred Wayta.

events.summary: Flashback: Wayta recalls fighting the Phyrexian invasion, sailing with the Brazen Coalition and finally returning to the Sun Empire to join Huatli's expedition.
events.quote: She'd left the pirates and returned to the Sun Empire a year older

events.summary: Quint tastes a fragment from a pile of broken pottery and identifies it as bone.
events.quote: He picked something up with his trunk and touched it to his tongue.

events.summary: The expedition finds a chasm of glowing green fog crossed by glyph-marked stones.
events.quote: Caparocti dropped a pebble into the fog.

events.summary: Wayta deduces the stone path from the poem and sets out across the chasm.
events.quote: Let me try, Warrior-Poet.

events.summary: Wayta steps on a wrong stone, it falls, and the platforms begin to rearrange.
events.quote: Without warning, it fell into the fog.

events.summary: Caparocti hauls Wayta to safety and crosses with her.
events.quote: Strong hands grabbed her arms and hauled her up.

events.summary: Wayta touches the glyph panel in the poem's order, and the platforms form a solid bridge.
events.quote: The platforms slid together, forming a solid bridge, much easier to cross.

events.summary: Caparocti tells Wayta he is sure war with the Dusk Legion is coming and that the colonizers must be eliminated.
events.quote: The colonizers must be eliminated, or they will never stop trying to rule us.

events.summary: Malcolm and his crew descend elevator after elevator in the Downtown cenote, finding tracks of the missing residents all leading downward.
events.quote: each showed signs of its workers joining the mass exodus, ever downward.

events.summary: Malcolm and Breeches find a trail of abandoned tools and smeared greenish-black marks leading into a tunnel.
events.quote: A haphazard trail of tools seemed to lead into one of the tunnels rather than out, though it was hard to tell the difference.

events.summary: In a fungus-lit cavern they find stripped, mold-covered bones and see shapes moving in the dark.
events.quote: A pile of bones stripped clean of flesh and half-covered in black mold.

events.summary: A fungus-ridden living raptor corpse attacks, releasing spores, and more like it follow; Malcolm flees with Breeches.
events.quote: A horror emerged from the passage beside them.

events.summary: Vito sees a mosaic of Aclazotz and reflects on Bartolomé and Amalia, whom he suspects of hearing Aclazotz's call.
events.quote: Was she, too, hearing Aclazotz calling to her?

events.summary: Vito resolves that he alone is Aclazotz's instrument and will bring the god to Alta Torrezon.
events.quote: He would prove himself worthy by bringing Aclazotz to Alta Torrezon, ending the tiresome theological debates that plagued his people.

events.summary: Vito sacrifices another servant on an altar to open a second door.
events.quote: Clavileño and another soldier held the servant down as Vito cut his throat

events.summary: The door opens onto a vast underground desert of treacherous sand.
events.quote: now instead Vito faced a massive underground desert

events.summary: A scout is swallowed by the sand and vanishes.
events.quote: Without warning, too fast to make a sound, he vanished.

events.summary: Clavileño flies over the desert marking solid ground and the soldiers build a makeshift plank bridge.
events.quote: Clavileño's legs dissolved into smoke as he rose into the air.

events.summary: Mantis-spider creatures attack the column, seizing and devouring a porter and a prisoner.
events.quote: Their arms snapped out, snagging a porter and a prisoner, dragging them away as they screamed and flailed.

events.summary: Vito orders the vampires to purge the creatures; Amalia freezes one with magic and Bartolomé beheads another with his whip.
events.quote: Bartolomé unfurled a whip and lashed out, wrapping it around the monster's neck.

events.summary: The expedition tallies its losses on reaching the far side of the desert.
events.quote: They reported that beyond the two taken by the monsters, a porter, a soldier, two prisoners, and a horse had fallen into the sand.

events.summary: Vito privately resolves to eliminate Bartolomé if he hinders the mission.
events.quote: If Bartolomé tried to hinder the mission, he would be eliminated.

events.summary: Quint beholds a huge underground fungus-covered stone city, reminiscent of Zantafar.
events.quote: Before him stretched a cavern many miles across, from edge to edge filled with stone buildings and narrow streets.

events.summary: Quint finds a purple-pink poncho and beads in a plaza and uses the spell The Rousing on it.
events.quote: Quint finally found a pile of cloth and beads, surprisingly well preserved.

events.summary: The spell summons the ghost of an old man who has forgotten his name.
events.quote: The poncho rose, hovering in the air.

events.summary: The ghost cries that it must warn Oteclan of a mycoid infestation and that the door must be closed, then runs off.
events.quote: I must warn Oteclan of the mycoid infestation. It's too late. The door must be closed!

events.summary: Malcolm sings to enthrall the fungus-ridden dinosaurs and his crew, and cuts the creatures apart.
events.quote: Malcolm began to sing.

events.summary: Malcolm and Breeches regroup, then notice black fungal veins spreading from the crew's wounds, though everyone says they feel fine.
events.quote: Black marks like scabs had replaced slices and gouges

events.summary: Amalia and the expedition reach a cavern with a lava waterfall and a deserted-looking settlement.
events.quote: a thunderous fall of lava cascaded down the side of a wall, bright enough to light the entire space

events.summary: A strange swordsman runs toward the vampires, pursued by pale goblin-like creatures.
events.quote: Someone emerged from a nearby building, chased by a half-dozen smaller figures.

events.summary: Amalia alters her map with her enchanted quill, removing part of the bridge so the pursuers fall.
events.quote: With a delicate scratch of her quill, Amalia changed the map, and changed the world.

events.summary: The rescued man introduces himself as Kellan, from Eldraine.
events.quote: I'm Kellan

events.summary: Vito refuses to help Kellan, but Amalia takes responsibility for him and Vito grudgingly accepts.
events.quote: I'll take responsibility for him.

events.summary: Bartolomé warns Amalia not to defy Vito openly again.
events.quote: Do not openly defy him again
